comment: Independent C-first trap.c trapeffect_landmine -> keep_saddle_with_steedcorpse. Knight creates a tame saddled rothe at initial hero level before raising hero durability, so adj_lev does not inflate the low-level steed. First C scout establishes actual adjacent rothe position and inventory letters before choosing mount/stethoscope actions. Landmine death and scattered corpse/saddle relocation are not assumed from creation alone. Own expanded C map places hero (56,7), saddled rothe (55,6), stethoscope i. Inspect northwest, mount northwest with source wizard force yes, then inspect downward while mounted; require actual low steed HP before designing a mine crossing.
